title: Carry principal, expiry, and trust origin on every graph invocation
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He runs `execution_token` so a parent CapabilityEnvelope (principal, expiry, trust origin, authorization epoch) can only attenuate into children: a child cannot raise the epoch, swap principal or trust origin, or outlive the parent's expiry. Tracks MH-DOTS-01[^insp-dots-01].
implementation: `CapabilityEnvelope.narrow()` via product verb `execution_token` (`cli_policy_verbs`); walk-bag registers `in`/`out` carry parent and outcomes. Related: `fangore_capability_envelope_narrow`.
validation: Harness `user_story` walks `execution_token`; expects attenuate ok and refuse raise/swap/outlive attempts.
